title: MrOpenRequest
description:
Body of `POST /v1/tasks/{prefix}/mr`: the branch that `loom pr` pushed, in the project of
its remote.

dry_run.description:
When true, loomd sends nothing to the forge and changes no task: the result gives the
requests it would send.

host.description: The forge host of the remote, such as `github.com`.

project.description: The project path on the host, such as `acme/shop`.
